title: Self-Harness API Schema
description: Schema mapping the request and response payloads for the reasoning-core Self-Harnessing heuristics optimizer.

rules.description: The current operational rules or heuristics to optimize.

context.description: The target domain or context for which to optimize the rules (e.g. speed, accuracy, resource constraints).

performanceMetrics.description: Optional performance telemetry to guide the optimizer (e.g., token usage, duration, pass rates).

sandboxCheckPassed.description: Indicates whether the proposed rule revisions passed the constitutional safety sandbox check.

modifications.description: Detailed log of rule modifications proposed by the self-harness run.

errorMessage.description: Details of any validation or sandbox errors if sandboxCheckPassed is false.
